# Palette colours

The master palette (A11.3, `PRE-01`, `PRE-20`): every colour on screen is one of these, in the version of the hour (`data/palette/light.md`).
One entry per family of the approved mockup's palette, in its order; a colour's palette index is its position over the whole palette, families in number order, so index 0 is `void` and the indices equal the mockup's.
New families are added at the end, so no index ever moves.

## Void

The empty background behind the world: the colour of nothing drawn, index 0 of every palette texture.

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Colours | void `#0d0b14` |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "void"
name = "Void"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["PRE-01", "PRE-20"]
colours = [["void", "#0d0b14"]]
```
